newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo rubber mostly lower, fails to gain on yen.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo rubber mostly lower, fails to gain on yen.

text.p: Tokyo rubber futures ended lower except for the March contract on Friday due to fresh selling after prices failed to gain on the yen's weakness against the dollar, traders said.
Prices ranged from 1.0 yen per kg lower to 1.0 firmer, with the most-active benchmark June ending down 1.0 yen at 144.5.
Activity was sluggish amid a lack of fresh incentives and ahead of the spot expiry next Monday.
The market started the day on a weaker tone. "Sentiment turned bearish after the benchmark June fell under support at 145.0 yen," one trader said.
